desc: Join this machine to an EasyTier mesh network: P2P hole punching first, relayed through public or self-hosted nodes when needed
noInstances: No instances yet. Add one to join this machine to an EasyTier network
confirmDelete: Delete this instance? Its easytier-core process is stopped.
namePlaceholder: e.g. home or office; empty uses the network name
noPeers: No other nodes in the network yet. Check that the network name and secret match and that at least one node address is reachable
programHelp: Leave empty to look in bin under the config directory and then PATH; easytier-cli is looked up in the same directory
networkNamePlaceholder: Nodes with the same name and secret can reach each other
networkSecretPlaceholder: Leave empty for a network without a secret
networkSecretHelp: Passed through an environment variable, never on the command line, and hidden in logs. Use a strong secret: anyone who knows the name and secret can join the network
peersPlaceholder:
One per line, e.g.
tcp://public.easytier.cn:11010
udp://203.0.113.5:11010
peersHelp: Nodes to connect to at startup (a public shared node or your own relay). Protocols: tcp, udp, ws, wss, quic, wg. Traffic is encrypted end to end, but a public node can see who connects to it
dhcpHelp: EasyTier picks a free virtual IP in the network
ipv4Help: Leave empty to only forward data between other nodes, without creating a network interface
hostnamePlaceholder: Leave empty to use the system hostname
listenersHelp: Must be written as protocol://address:port. Empty means no port is opened and the node only connects outward (hole punching and relaying still work). Open these ports in the firewall of a relay or public node
noTunHelp: No TUN device or privileges needed; recommended in containers. Reach the network through port forwards
devNamePlaceholder: Leave empty to let EasyTier choose
portForwardsHelp: Format protocol://local-address:port/network-address:port. Binding to 127.0.0.1 is recommended: a forward has no authentication
portForwardsPublic: A forward bound to a non-local address has no authentication; any device that can reach that address can use it to enter the network. Bind to 127.0.0.1 unless you need it
proxyNetworksHelp: Share a local subnet with the network so other nodes can reach devices in it. 192.168.1.0/24->10.1.0.0/24 maps it to another subnet
enableExitNodeHelp: Let other nodes send all their traffic through this machine
exitNodesPlaceholder: Virtual IPs, one per line, e.g. 10.126.126.9
exitNodesHelp: Send all traffic through these exit nodes, in priority order. Routing everything through another node changes the system routes; use with care
latencyFirstHelp: Relay through the lowest latency path instead of the fewest hops
kcpProxyHelp: Carry TCP streams over KCP; lowers latency on networks with UDP packet loss
quicProxyHelp: Carry TCP streams over QUIC; lowers latency on networks with UDP packet loss
envPlaceholder: One KEY=VALUE per line, e.g. ET_FILE_LOG_LEVEL=debug
envHelp: Passed to easytier-core; see the EasyTier docs for the ET_ options
